newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung completes plant in Kumi complex.
newsitem.headline: Samsung completes plant in Kumi complex.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd, a unit of Samsung Group, said on Friday it completed the second plant in its information and communication equipment production complex in Kumi.

The plant has started to production of communication goods such as CT-2 monitors, digital mobile phones, wireless phones and pagers, and multimedia goods such as printers and hard disk drives, the company said in a statement.
Samsung invested 300 billion won on construction of the plant and plans to invest 200 billion more by 1999, Samsung said.
The statement said the total turnover from the Kumi production complex is expected to be 3.6 trillion won in 1996 and 6.35 trillion won in 1998.
The second plant is expected to see a turnover of 1.34 trillion won in 1996 and three trillion won in 1998.
